name: Lyo.FeatureFlags.AspNetCore
tagline: RequireFeature returns 404 when a flag is off.
description: UseFeatureFlags runs after routing and authentication, and before authorization, so a disabled flag is 404 instead of 401. It does not register IFeatureFlagService. The host still calls AddFeatureFlags or AddFeatureFlagsFromConfiguration. An open route does not resolve the service. A gated route with no service returns an empty 500. A flag that is off returns an empty 404 and does not run the handler.
features: **[RequireFeature]** on an MVC controller or action. Several attributes must all be enabled.
**Minimal APIs.** A method-group attribute is metadata. A lambda or a route group uses RequireFeature.

**Caller mapping.** User id is lyo:user, then sub, then NameIdentifier, then Identity.Name. There is no tenant claim unless TenantClaimType is set. A space-delimited scope claim is split. Attributes stay empty unless ContextFactory sets them.
**ContextFactory.** Replaces that mapping. A null return is an anonymous caller.
